cohort: Women from the Swedish Medical Birth Register with their first two or first three pregnancies were included.
finding: Using survival models, a previous cesarean section was primarily associated with a longer gestational duration of subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: While standard logistic regression suggested an increased risk of both spontaneous preterm and postterm birth after a previous cesarean section, survival models indicated that the main association was a prolongation of the subsequent pregnancy's gestational duration.
